title: Fix the round-2 family A review findings in managed custody: the settlement race and the half-written pending journal
outcome: Fix the round-2 family A review findings in managed custody: the settlement race and the half-written pending journal
acceptance: Settlement can no longer discard a concurrent writer's write-ahead record: it either takes the AuditReservation before the post-commit custody check and observes custody again under it, or re-validates each write's artifact presence under the lock in settle_journal and refuses on a difference (review finding at src/task_sync/retention/audit/journal.rs:210). A concurrency behaviour test proves it

A lock-free reader never sees a half-written managed.pending: publication writes under a unique temporary name and renames only when the file is complete and synced, or an unreadable pending file under a held reservation is reported as a retryable busy state, not as a call for managed_audit recovery (journal.rs:328). A behaviour test covers it

The patch touches only family A paths, is based on candidate effdb26ade080007acc162f3ca5bb6ea3aa22af3, and goes back to the integrator as a commit with its focused verification. The two Notes (audit.rs:716 exact retry under active managed custody; resolution.rs:67 narrowed unused-id check) are either fixed or answered with reasons
